PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
  ACTION SUMMARY
  JULY 18, 2023, COMMISSION MEETING

Commission Members Present: Larry Giannone ( Chair), Edward Rodriguez, Patrick Jones,
Tim Hughes, Karol Curtis, Albert Behr
Commission Members Absent: Morgan Kostolefsky, Bob Olander
City Representatives: City Manager Chris Constantin, Captain Walid Ashrafnia

 ORAL COMMUNICATIONS  COMMENTS/ RECOMMENDATIONS
  Kathi Began discussed wanting to review Flock
  hits in her HOA. Her building at 133 E. Bonita
  had some suspicious person in a morning, pulled
  a mask down, and tried to break the window
  with a rock. The suspect has tattoos on his arms.
  She will provide video to the LASD for
  investigation.
  Vilma Acevedo - Monitoring the park and ride
  in Via Verde. There is a patrol service from
  6am to 6pm, yet, break- ins are happening.
  There are nine break ins in the last 4 weeks.
  This is a County area.
  Greg Tober - LASD has been great and have
  lived here for decades. Is interested in the
  Public Safety Commission.
  Ryan Vienna – Highlighted that the Boards,
  Commission, and Committee Handbook has
  been revised. Encouraged members to volunteer
  for the commissions. On Thursday at 6:30 at La
  Canada High School, there will be a seminar
  called “ When disaster strikes,” for emergency
  response. Boots on the ground perspective of
  the Turkey earthquake will be presented. CERT
 July 18, 2023 Public Safety Commission Minutes  Page 2

  at La Crescenta Valley station will make a
  presentation to plug CERT countywide.
  Emmett Badar thanked members of the
  commission and encouraged them to come on
  Sunday to participate in the Booster Club annual
  car show. Funds support volunteers at the San
  Dimas Station.

 BUSINESS ITEMS  COMMENTS/ RECOMMENDATIONS
 3.1 Discussion of January – May 2023 Crime  The report is a new format that is more
 Statistics and Trends – New Format ( Captain  streamlined to allow for quicker review of crime
 Walid Ashrafnia)  statistics.
  Captain Ashrafnia presented the statistics related
  to Part 1 crimes. Captain Ashrafnia updated on
  some of the burglaries. Aggravated assaults
  were mostly incidents that both parties knew
  each other with only 3 that were stranger
  assaults. Thefts are down. Property crimes are
  down overall.
  Deputy Martin and Dane Bode from LA Fire
  were recognized by Congresswoman Napolitano
  at her First Responder’ s breakfast.
  Two deputies are being promoted to sergeant.
  One sergeant was promoted to lieutenant.
  City Manager Constantin updated on traffic
  collision statistics. Sgt Polanco has identified
  priority areas for traffic enforcement.
 3.2 Discussion of Status of 740, 800 Foothill  City Manager Constantin updated the
 Permanent Supportive Housing Project and  commission on this project. City held a joint
 Funding Through Their Notice of Funding  meeting with the City La Verne with the project
 Availability 28 ( City Manager Chris Constantin)  developer and County departments. Over 300
  residents attended.

 3.3 Update on National Night Out Event  Monique Campos, the City’ s Crime Prevention
 Planning – August 1, 2023 ( Captain Walid  officer at the LASD San Dimas Station,
 Ashrafnia)  presented the plans for National Night Out. The
  event is Tuesday, August 1st from 5pm to 7pm.
  This is a national- wide event where residents
  and law enforcement come together to
 July 18, 2023 Public Safety Commission Minutes  Page 3

  emphasize community, meet and great station
  resources, and to combat crime.

  Station is working on a Wildlife Awareness
  campaign to educate residents on snake and
  animal safety awareness. Also working on fire
  prevention education.

  Coffee with a Cop coming to In-House Coffee
  next Thursday, July 27th at 7am. This is the
  opportunity to connect with law enforcement.

 3.4 Discussion of Changes to Boards,  City Manager Constantin provided an update on
 Commissions, and Committees and Status of  the changes and process for nomination,
 the Current Public Safety Commission ( City  appointment, and operations of the commissions.
 Manager Chris Constantin)
 REPORTS  COMMENTS/ RECOMMENDATIONS
 Commission, City Council, and Staff Liaison  Commission provided updates.
 Reports
  Karol Curtis thanked the City and LASD on their
  efforts related to homelessness. She sees less on
  the Bonita corridor.

  Patrick Jones wants to know calls for service and
  not just the crime stats. In terms of rapes, do we
  know if they are all stranger rapes. When school
  starts, school bus enforcement seems necessary.
  Ranging Waters has had a lot of issues with
  traffic impacts in Via Verde. Sad that we did
  away with the caravan for National Night Out.
  Some businesses have non-prosecution policies
  which negatively impact the City. This is a
  public safety issue.

  Edward Rodriguez likes the National Night Out
  event in the park.

  City Manager updated on the ongoing oversight
  of the LASD contract. Updated on the City’ s
  homeless efforts.

  No City Council report as the Council acted to
  remove staff liaisons from serving on the
  commissions.
The meeting adjourned at 7:13 PM.
